\section[pakṣi]{\ml{പക്ഷി} (pakṣi) — a bird}

\label{lesson:ML-C138-bird}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for an aeroplane, then the Malayalam for an auto.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പക്ഷി}}
\textbf{\ml{പക്ഷി}} (\emph{pakṣi}) — \textquotedblleft{}a bird\textquotedblright{}. A \textbf{\ml{കാക്ക}} is one.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The general word for anything with wings.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pakṣi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pakṣi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{pakṣi}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for an aeroplane, then the Malayalam for an auto, then say \emph{pakṣi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പക്ഷി} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A bird\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
